choices.why: The verb ἀνατρέπω means to overturn, overthrow, or refute a position; here it indicates the Savior directly contradicted the false teaching.
δόγμα is a decree or doctrine, and παράνομος describes it as contrary to the law or divine order.
The participle ἁμαρτανούσας modifies ψυχάς, indicating the souls are the ones committing the sin.
The compound preposition προ- indicates priority in time; the soul existed before the body.
οἰκεῖος refers to domestic or family matters; the sins are those of one's own household.
The verb implies a close, interwoven joining; the soul is interwoven with the body.
This is a standard phrase for the deeds or actions of God.

lemmas.gloss: for the sake of / because of

pass_a_gloss: In this, the Savior himself refutes a lawless doctrine. For some thinking souls sinning for the sake of retribution from heaven to be sent into a body, and sometimes the soul of the body remaining by itself, and sometimes for the sake of sins of the household to be knit with bodies, and then to be able to have the woman in the belly, when a soul sins, cutting off this error, the Christ being asked said: Neither this one sinned nor his parents, but that the works of God might be revealed.
pass_b_english: In this, the Savior himself refutes a lawless doctrine. For some thinking souls sinning for the sake of retribution from heaven to be sent into a body, and sometimes the soul of the body existing beforehand, and sometimes for the sake of sins of the household to be knit with bodies, and then to be able to have the woman in the belly, when a soul sins, cutting off this error, the Christ being asked said: Neither this one sinned nor his parents, but that the works of God might be revealed.
The text is a fragment of a larger work, likely a homily or commentary on the Gospel of John, specifically addressing the question of why a person suffers or is born into a state of sin.
source_text:
Fragmenta in Joannem
Jo , 3 Ἐν τούτῳ δὲ ἀνέτρεπεν αὐτὸς ὁ σωτὴρ δόγμα παράνομον.
ὑπονοούντων γάρ τινων ψυχὰς ἁμαρτανούσας ἐξ οὐρανοῦ τιμωρίας ἕνεκεν εἰς σῶμα
πέμπεσθαι καί ποτε μὲν καθ' ἑαυτὴν προϋπάρχουσαν τὴν ψυχὴν τοῦ σώματος
<μένειν>, ποτὲ δὲ οἰκείων ἁμαρτημάτων χάριν σώμασι συμπλέκεσθαι καὶ τότε κατὰ
γαστρὸς ἔχειν τὴν γυναῖκα δύνασθαι ὅτε τις ψυχὴ ἁμαρτάνῃ, ἀναιρῶν τὴν τοιαύτην
πλάνην ἐρωτηθεὶς ὁ Χριστὸς ἔλεγεν· οὔτε οὗτος ἥμαρτεν οὔτε οἱ γονεῖς αὐτοῦ, ἀλλ'
ἵνα φανερωθῇ τὰ ἔργα θεοῦ.
